description: Shared base preset for all bright-room repositories

packageRules.description: npm も 7 日に揃える(config:best-practices が extends する security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm は npm を 3 日にするため)。lockFileMaintenance / pin / bump などの適用除外は上書きしないよう updateTypes を絞る

customManagers.description: Update any version annotated with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment (an optional `@sha256:...` digest is tracked as currentDigest)
matchStrings: # renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>[a-z0-9._-]+?) depName=(?<depName>[^\s]+?)(?: packageName=(?<packageName>[^\s]+?))?(?: versioning=(?<versioning>[^\s]+?))?(?: extractVersion=(?<extractVersion>[^\s]+?))?(?: registryUrl=(?<registryUrl>[^\s]+?))?[ \t]*\r?\n[ \t]*(?:ENV +|ARG +|export +)?[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\s*(?::=|\?=|[:=])\s*["']?(?<currentValue>[^\s"']+?)(?:@(?<currentDigest>sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}))?(?:["']|[ \t]|\r?\n|$)
